numericalMethod: D2 1DOF implicit Newmark solver, elastic (very high yield threshold), one roof mass and equivalent portal shear stiffness
outputPrecision: Time histories rounded to 6 decimals only for browser transport; full-precision D2 residual and energy diagnostics are preserved.

frameStiffness.source: Euler-Bernoulli 2D portal finite-element matrix assembly, 6 free roof DOF with fixed bases, static lateral unit-force condensation
frameStiffness.catalogSource: D2/src/core/catalog.mjs · actual HEB260/IPE330 profile A and Iy

input.recordType: Analytical diagnostic ground-motion waveform, NOT recorded historical earthquake and NOT calibrated NTC/Eurocode design record.

comparison.viscousRepresentation: Equivalent linear viscous matrix Ceff=Caxial × cos²(theta) on one reduced roof degree of freedom. D2 source validator accepts only coincident connector endpoints; the diagonal architectural representation is an analytical direction-cosine projection, NOT a validated direct beam-to-beam damper connection.
comparison.modelingAssumptions: 3D viewer depicts an extrusion of the physical 2D steel portal. Numerical analysis uses an equivalent single roof degree of freedom and D2 native Newmark MDOF solver; no direct geometric seismicDevice in Kratos or NTC design verification.
